name: Strategy Competition Proof

steps.evidence: unlabeled founder pool, accepted resource tradeoffs and heterogeneous competition baseline
dynamic shared-patch abundance competition; 19/20 founders >=1% in baseline
anonymous trait clusters plus environment-dependent niche enrichment and uniform negative control
six-seed robustness, uniform negative control and 24-cycle deep horizon

criteria: multiple persistent strategies survive heterogeneous competition
coexistence repeats across multiple seeds and longer horizon
uniform control does not invent spatial niche enrichment
anonymous clusters are diagnostic only and not species identities
accepted resource tradeoffs remain the source of competition consequences
no predefined species or biome placement rules

scope_note: P1C is accepted as an ecological-trait-only strategy competition proof. Developmental morphology is not yet in strategy space; PH3 morphology-to-resource convergence is not claimed and remains a separate extension before morphology-aware competition claims.
truth_boundary: Research-only strategy proof. No canonical species, biome placement, migration, production persistence, authority, networking or renderer-owned ecology truth.
next: Close ECO.P1 aggregate and continue ECO.PH starting with PH0/PH1 before morphology-aware competition extensions or P2 dispersal history.
